damageoverlay.config.default_color.toolt:
Colour of the damage text as 0xRRGGBB, used when the caller does not pass its own colour.
The alpha channel is ignored: opacity is driven by the fade-out animation.
damageoverlay.config.drop_shadow.tooltip:
Whether the damage text is drawn with a drop shadow.
Turning this off makes the text harder to read against bright backgrounds, but slightly cheaper to render.
damageoverlay.config.lifetime.tooltip: How long a popup stays on screen, in milliseconds, fade-out included.
damageoverlay.config.rise_pixels.tooltip: Total vertical distance, in GUI pixels, a popup travels from its origin over its whole lifetime.
damageoverlay.config.spread.tooltip:
Random horizontal offset applied at spawn, in blocks, so several hits on the same block do not overlap exactly.
Set to 0 to always spawn at the exact origin.
damageoverlay.config.min_slope.tooltip:
Lower bound of the random slope k used by the popup trajectory y = kx.
Both bounds must stay positive to keep the motion in the first quadrant.
damageoverlay.config.max_slope.tooltip:
Upper bound of the random slope k.
Smaller slopes drift further sideways, larger slopes rise more vertically.
Must be strictly greater than the minimum slope.
